questions.q: What is the capital of China?
questions.explanation: Beijing is the capital of China; Shanghai is its largest city.

questions.q: Which is the smallest continent in the world?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent by land area.

questions.q: Who is the national poet of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Allama Muhammad Iqbal is honoured as the national poet of Pakistan.

questions.q: What is the currency of the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: The UK uses the pound sterling, not the euro.

questions.q: Which river flows through the city of Lahore?
questions.explanation: Lahore is situated on the banks of the River Ravi.

questions.q: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa is the capital of Canada; Toronto is its largest city.

questions.q: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
questions.explanation: Russia is the largest country by land area.

questions.q: How many provinces are there in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Pakistan has four provinces: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

questions.q: Which sea borders Pakistan to the south?
questions.explanation: Pakistan's southern coastline lies along the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara is the capital of Turkey; Istanbul is its largest city.
